comment: Same bug as game:recipes/grid/rawbrick (see porcelain-clay.json): fitnshard binds clay-* to an unnamed `type` and emits rawbrick-{type}, so porcelain clay resolves to a rawbrick-porcelain that does not exist. fitnshard ships four rawbrick recipes (one per grid arrangement), all needing the same restriction.

Same bug again: lithodipyra binds clay-* to `type` and emits fitnshard:lithodipyra-{type}-raw, which fitnshard only defines for its own colour set — porcelain isn't one of them, so the recipe fails to resolve with porcelain clay present.
